1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 12 m de altura, de hojas aovadas con ápice agudo e inflorescencia densa de flores sentadas; su corteza produce un jugo lechoso y cáustico. (Anacardiaceae; Comocladia dentata).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching a height of up to 12 m, with ovate leaves having an acute apex and dense inflorescence of seated flowers; its bark produces a milky and caustic sap. (Anacardiaceae; Comocladia dentata).
